6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Razorclaw the Butcher

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Razorclaw's autoattacks now properly manaburn as intended.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Commander Springvale

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Commander Springvale will now cast 'Divine Shield' at low HP.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Commander Springvale will now cast 'Holy Light' on friendly units more   reliably.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Commander Springvale will now cast 'Devotion Aura'.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Odo the Blindwatcher

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Odo the Blindwatcher should now properly aggro upon attacking either of his   bats.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Wolf Master Nandos

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Wolf Master Nandos is no longer linked to his pack.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: All the wolves in Wolf Master Nandos' pack are now linked. (You should now be able to pull the wolves separately from Nandos, as   originally intended)

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Archmage Arugal is no longer completely unscripted and should now be a challenging encounter for level appropriate players.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: He will now make regular use of his 'Shadow Port' spell, teleporting to   various platforms to escape the players' attacks.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Void Bolt has been reverted to its previous Classic state, to match his   higher level and increased stats. (From 222-258 to 255-296)

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Threat will reset upon use of his 'Shadow Port' spell, so tanks will need   to pick up aggro quickly.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: He will now use Thundershock to stun players that are in melee range.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: He will now use Arugal's Curse to charm and transform a player into a   Shadowfang Glutton for 10 seconds.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Aggro dialogue has been implemented.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Dialogue upon Cursing a player has been implemented.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Dialogue upon killing a player has been implemented.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Scarlet Monastery Library:

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan has been completely rescripted.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan will now cast 'Arcane Explosion' frequently.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan will now cast 'Polymorph', if multiple players are present.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan will now cast the correct 10 yard AoE version of 'Silence'. (Previously, he was silencing a single target.)

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan will now reliably cast 'Arcane Bubble' at the correct HP threshold, followed by his large AoE spell 'Detonation'.

6.author: AkashaGM
6.description: Arcanist Doan has been given the appropriate spell/ability immunities and can no longer be interrupted or silenced.

6.author: Grievuuz
6.description: Next server restart, Dark Iron Landmines should no longer be shouting "die, mortal!" while arming.
